outcome: Length of hospital stay (LOS) after cesarean section
cohort: Mothers who underwent cesarean section in Friuli Venezia Giulia (Italy) during 2005-2015
finding: The study found a decreasing trend in LOS after cesarean section over time, with shorter LOS associated with parity, history of CS, and longer LOS linked to non-EU mothers and various obstetric conditions.
mod_finding: Length of hospital stay varied depending on the mode of delivery (planned vs. urgent/emergency).
